91805.overview:
Space Raiders is a distant clone of Defender for the Arcadia 2001. The player pilots a spacefighter ship capable of both horizontal and vertical movement that is charged with shooting lasers at mutants and flying saucers that periodically appear on the screen. Additionally, there are missile launching bases that can fire upon the player, but these bases can be disabled by bombing them. The player's spacefighter ship also features an energy meter that counts down from 40 seconds and can be partially re-energized by docking at disabled missile bases.

The object of this 1-player game is to score as many points as possible by destroying enemies with the five lives provided. Space Raiders also features a pausing feature known as "freezing," which was relatively uncommon at the time of the game's release in 1982.

126471.overview: Spiders is a 2D shoot'em up, similar to Space Invaders or Galaga. The player controls a ship and fights against waves of spiders. The gameplay is typical for fixed screen shooters. The player's ship is at the bottom of the screen, can move left or right, and shoots enemies appearing from the top of the screen. The spiders can create webs, special structures the player must also destroy.

126472.overview: Star Chess is a game of chess for two players. The rules are based on standard chess rules but the pieces are represented by space ships. There are some additional game mechanics such as the ability to fire missiles, pieces have shields that defend them and pieces can warp into hyperspace when in trouble. After warping the piece will return at a random time and place on the board. There is no option for playing against an AI.

126474.overview:
Chō Jikū Yōsai Macross is the very first game based on the classic anime series, released for the Bandai Arcadia.

The player controls a Valkyrie fighter and is tasked with attacking a Zentradi ship. Gameplay consists of two distinct sections: The first is a top-down shooting section. The enemy ship launches defenders that shoot at the Valkyrie. Their shots must be evaded and all craft destroyed. Only then can the Valkyrie board the enemy which leads to the second section, a platform-type game, for which the Valkyrie changes into its Battroid (mecha) form. Through two screens, the Valkyrie must shoot at enemy mecha while evading their shots. Barriers in the floors must be shot to get to the lower levels. At the bottom of the second screen, the enemy's reactor awaits. Shooting it triggers a countdown sequence. The Valkyrie must reach the top of the first level in time to escape. Finishing the second level restarts the game.
